'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Battle of Donbas (2022)|Battle of Donbas]]
****Russian [[major general]] [[Roman Kutuzov (general)|Roman Kutuzov]] is killed in [[Mykolaivka, Luhansk Oblast|Mykolaivka]], [[Luhansk Oblast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-general-killed-eastern-ukraine-russian-state-media-reporter-says-2022-06-05/ (Reuters)] [https://www.pravda.com.ua/eng/news/2022/06/5/7350717/ (''Ukrayinska Pravda'')]
***[[Russia]] launches [[airstrike]]s on the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] capital [[Kyiv]] for the first time since April 28. The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Defence Ministry]] says that the missile strikes targeted [[T-72]] tanks that had been supplied to Ukraine by several [[European Union|EU]] countries. At least one person is injured. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jun/05/russia-launches-air-strikes-into-kyiv-for-first-time-in-five-weeks (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Herder–farmer conflicts in Nigeria]]
**[[Owo church attack]]
***At least 50 people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] and [[Improvised explosive device|bombing]] inside a [[Catholic]] church in [[Owo]], [[Ondo State|Ondo]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/gunmen-kill-worshippers-during-church-service-nigeria-media-2022-06-05/ (Reuters)]
**[[Fulani herdsmen]] kill 32 people in four attacks in [[Kajuru]], [[Kaduna State]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-west-africa-abuja-6878a1154e78fb953a41e3e5189c5de9 (AP)]
*[[2021–2022 Democratic Republic of the Congo attacks]]; [[Allied Democratic Forces insurgency]]
**Suspected [[Allied Democratic Forces]] fighters kill at least 18 people in an attack on the village of Otomabere, [[Irumu Territory]] in the [[Ituri Province]] of the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/suspected-islamists-kill-least-18-east-congo-attack-2022-06-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Minimum wage in Germany]]
**The [[Bundestag]] votes 400–41, with 200 [[Abstention#International and national parliamentary procedures|abstentions]], to approve raising the [[minimum wage]] in [[Germany]] to [[€]]12 ([[$]]12.90) an hour. [https://www.dw.com/en/german-lawmakers-approve-12-minimum-wage/a-62020989 (DW)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Sitakunda fire and explosions]]
**At least 49 people are killed and over 400 others injured by a fire and explosions at a [[storage depot]] in [[Sitakunda]], [[Chittagong District]], [[Bangladesh]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-61693778 (BBC News)]
*[[Wildfires in 2022]]
**A large [[wildfire]] breaks out on the [[Hymettus]] [[mountain range]] near [[Athens]], [[Greece]]. A number of homes are damaged in the fire. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/wildfire-rages-near-athens-threatens-homes-2022-06-04/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology]] raises the alert status of [[Mount Bulusan]] to level 1 after the [[volcano]] experienced a [[phreatic eruption]]. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/phivolcs-bulusan-volcano-alert-level-june-5-2022/ (Rappler)]
*Two pilots are killed when their [[plane crash]]es in [[Ar-Ramtha]], [[Jordan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/jordanian-army-says-two-pilots-killed-plane-crash-2022-06-05/ (Reuters)]
*One person is killed and 14 others are injured by heavy thunderstorms and [[flash flood]]ing in [[France]]. [https://apnews.com/article/floods-storms-paris-thunderstorms-31c22c9090c4e1ab9b181588257ae7ef (AP)]
*Twenty-six people are killed and 4 others injured when a bus falls into a gorge in [[Uttarakhand]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/india/least-15-dead-indias-northern-state-after-bus-falls-into-gorge-2022-06-05/ (Reuters)] 
'''Health and environment'''
*[[2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
**[[Timeline of the 2022 monkeypox outbreak]]
***[[2022 monkeypox outbreak in the United States]]
****[[Hawaii]] reports a probable case of [[monkeypox]] in a person from [[Oahu]], becoming the first island region of the United States to report a case. [https://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/2022/06/03/hawaii-confirms-monkeypox-case-patient-tripler-army-medical-center/ (KGMB-TV)]
***[[Colombia]] reports its first confirmed case of monkeypox in a man who travelled from [[Spain]]. [https://24newsrecorder.com/world/160453 (24 News Recorder)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021–2022 North Korean missile tests]]
**[[North Korea]] fires at least eight short-range [[ballistic missile]]s into the [[Sea of Japan]] from several locations in the country. [https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2022/06/05/asia-pacific/north-korea-missile-launch-june-5/ (''The Japan Times'')]
*[[Russia–Serbia relations]]
**[[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Russia)|Russian Foreign Minister]] [[Sergey Lavrov]] cancels his scheduled visit to [[Serbia]] after neighbouring states in the [[Balkans]] refuse to let Lavrov's plane use their airspace. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-61698462 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Chattanooga shooting]]
**Three people are killed and 14 others are injured in a mass shooting in [[Chattanooga]], [[Tennessee]], [[United States]]. Three people are also hit by cars, with one person later dying. [https://apnews.com/article/chattanooga-tennessee-shootings-a0da450e728d20a8c99029aa037ba839 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Kazakh constitutional referendum]]
**[[Kazakhs]] go to the polls to vote on 56 amendments to the [[Constitution of Kazakhstan|constitution]] and [[President of Kazakhstan|President]] [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]]'s "Second Republic" proposals, among them the reduction of presidential powers, reform of the [[Parliament of Kazakhstan|Parliament]], the curbing of former President [[Nursultan Nazarbayev]]'s powers, and the creation of three new [[Regions of Kazakhstan|regions]]. [https://www.economist.com/asia/2022/06/02/kazakhstani-voters-may-revoke-their-ex-presidents-vast-privileges (''The Economist'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification]]
**[[Wales at the FIFA World Cup]]
***In [[association football]], [[Wales national football team|Wales]] defeats [[Ukraine national football team|Ukraine]] 1–0 at the [[Cardiff City Stadium]] to become the final team from UEFA to [[2022 FIFA World Cup qualification|qualify]] for the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] in [[Qatar]]. It is the first time that [[Wales]] has qualified for a [[FIFA World Cup]] since [[1958 FIFA World Cup|1958]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/6/5/ukraine-loses-1-0-to-wales-in-world-cup-match (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2022 French Open – Men's singles]]
**[[Rafael Nadal]] defeats [[Casper Ruud]] to win the men's singles tennis title at the [[2022 French Open]], extending his [[All-time tennis records – Men's singles|all-time record]] for the most [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] men's singles titles to 22. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/61693135 (BBC Sport)]
